description: For one track or one album: everything Audora still needs before that release could be submitted, and anything worth a second look that does not block it. That includes the stores' intake rules, checked against the uploaded master and cover themselves (WAV 16/24-bit 44.1 kHz stereo; square RGB JPG 3000–6000 px). Call this after writing, and again before telling the artist something is ready.

album_id.description: Check an album or EP. Give this or track_id, not both.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

track_id.description: Check a single. Give this or album_id, not both.
